top_signals.title: Pointed! Bloomberg's Weekly News Quiz For Risk-Takers
top_signals.summary: Pointed offers a strategic twist to the news quiz format, testing not just players’ knowledge of the news but also their confidence in their answers. Join Bloomberg's Lisa Mateo, Christina Ruffini, and Jeff Mason as they play and check out the quiz for yourself at Bloomberg.com  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: Stocks stumble on inflation fears, but 2 of our names give us reasons to stay bullish  cnbc.com

top_signals.title: Former Alameda CEO Caroline Ellison joins nonprofit charity Manifund
top_signals.summary: Former Alameda Research CEO Caroline Ellison has a new gig at the charity Manifund, its cofounder Austin Chen said Friday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Treasury urges banks to file cyber scam reports, noting nearly $13 billion in losses since 2023
top_signals.summary: As the cyber scam industry expands globally, the U.S. government wants banks to share more information about what's happening to their customers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
